title: SAT Central Ideas & Details: How to Find the Main Idea
description:
"Which choice best states the main idea of the text?" Most wrong answers on these questions are true. They just aren't the main idea. This lesson shows you how to find the one that is, plus how to handle detail questions, short stories, and poems.

You'll learn:
• The two kinds of Central Ideas and Details questions: main idea and detail
• Main idea: summarize the passage in one sentence before you look at the choices
• Detail: find the line that proves the answer
• How to read short story and poem passages for these questions
• The 5 traps: too narrow, too broad, not in the text, too extreme, and wrong person
• 6 practice questions from science, history, fiction, and poetry, with a harder one at the end

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. The story and poem excerpts were also written for this video. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Information and Ideas → Central Ideas and Details).
